regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing rotation: leadership sit in Big Banks (eligible, durable, trend, strong breadth) while Oil & Gas Producers rank first on raw score but sit OUTSIDE the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false, durability 0.19). Momentum is a focus lens only; the one validated edge is drawdown control via the gate, which is helping here.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Oil & Gas Producers regains ELIGIBILITY (durability_bar climbing back above the gate threshold) while Banks hold leadership — if Oil & Gas re-enters the eligible set with rising breadth, the leadership handoff would become CONFIRMED and retire this watch.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the highest-scoring ELIGIBLE theme (score 0.99, rank 2) with the strongest durability bar (0.8), full breadth (1.0), trend Hurst tag, and no crowding. Oil & Gas ranks first but is ineligible via the absolute-trend gate, so Banks are the leading gated theme. This is a direction, not a prediction.
theses.dissent: Momentum rank-IC is ~0 on clean sectors, so the rank ordering itself carries no validated forward edge; Banks may simply be a crowded late-trend holding pattern that stalls.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO lags XEG.TO by 5% and closes below its own 20-day mean before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: Consumer Staples is eligible, durable (0.79), trend-tagged, and fully broad, but it is CROWDED (crowding_z=1.03, crowded=true). Crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade. The trend-gate discipline says staying long is defensible but with humility.
theses.dissent: Crowding often marks late-cycle participation; further upside may be limited without fresh flow.

falsifier.text: XST.TO loses its trend tag (Hurst flips to mean-revert) and breadth drops below 0.6 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals ranks near the bottom (rank 15, score -1.065), is ineligible (durability_bar 0.1), has zero breadth, and a mean-revert Hurst tag. The absolute-trend gate excludes it, consistent with the one validated edge being shake-out avoidance.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tags can occasionally mark oversold bounces, but the gate explicitly does not time re-entry on this market.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO flips to eligible with durability_bar above 0.5 and breadth above 0.5 before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
